notes:
【实验版】改动较大，可能有未发现的问题。不想升级可以点更新卡片上的「稍后再说 / ✕」。
朗读服务目录：内置 20 家朗读服务（OpenRouter、Gemini、ElevenLabs、Azure、MiniMax、Fish Audio、硅基流动、火山豆包、阿里云百炼、智谱、阶跃等），每家各存各的 Key、模型与音色，点一下切换；也可以自己加 OpenAI 兼容端点，或粘贴一段 JSON 接入任意语音接口。原来的「AI 语音 / Gemini」配置自动迁移。
液态玻璃界面：面板与悬浮件改为半透明的玻璃材质（Android 11 起都是真模糊，13 起带边缘折射），可在「阅读样式 → 外观」里关闭；模型与音色不再层层叠面板，改为同一张面板里翻页。
英文界面重做：标签不再被切断，行高与字距按英文排版，文案精简。
API Key 落盘前用系统密钥库加密，备份与换机带不走明文。
修复：「上一章」图标画错位置；书架按界面语言排序；面板重新打开时回到顶部。
notesEn:
[Experimental] Bigger changes; there may be undiscovered issues. To skip it, tap the X on the update card.
Voice services: 20 built-in providers (OpenRouter, Gemini, ElevenLabs, Azure, MiniMax, Fish Audio, SiliconFlow, Volcengine, Alibaba Bailian, Zhipu, StepFun and more). Each keeps its own key, model and voice; switch with one tap. Add any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or paste a JSON recipe for any other speech API. Your existing AI voice / Gemini setup migrates automatically.
Liquid glass: panels and floating controls are translucent glass with real blur on Android 11 and up (edge refraction on Android 13+). Turn it off under Reading style > Appearance. Model and voice pickers are now pages inside one panel.
English interface reworked: no more clipped labels, Latin line heights and spacing, shorter copy.
API keys are encrypted with the system keystore before they are saved.
Fixed: the Previous chapter icon was drawn out of place; the library sorts by the interface language; panels reopen at the top.
